fields.statement: Find it, hear about it: rhiza search finds model nodes by their text and the model app filters with it, and the daemon runs an owner-configured command for each new inbox item so a phone can hear about it

fields.quote: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.
fields.statement: Milestone 14 carves text search out of the Area views umbrella and adds an inbox notify hook under the landed notifications capability; Area hooks' model-event-hooks stays in its umbrella

rhiza search matches live nodes' handles and field text, ranked; as-is and to-be views use an FTS5 table kept in step with the index's nodes (schema version bumped), and what-if views scan in memory; hits give handle, ID, kind, path, matched field and a snippet, paged with --limit and a cursor; the model app filters with / through the same op
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: The daemon runs a notify command, from --notify-command or else git config rhiza.notifyCommand, through sh -c in the repo root once per new inbox item, with the item's JSON on stdin and RHIZA_INBOX_KIND, RHIZA_INBOX_ID, RHIZA_INBOX_CHANGE and RHIZA_INBOX_TITLE set; it records hooked items in its own state apart from Rex notifications so it runs with or without Rex; a failing or timed-out (10 s) command is logged with the item ID and not retried
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)
